question: Show customer name and total order value.
generated_sql: SELECT SUM(o.total_amount) AS sum_total_amount, c.name FROM public.orders AS o INNER JOIN public.customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.name LIMIT 100
